en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad European boulevard with tram tracks and horse‑drawn vehicles in the foreground. On the right dominates an ornate multi‑storey Art Nouveau / historicist corner building with towers, sculptural decoration and a central clock‑like feature. The ground floor hosts many shops and cafés with striped awnings and German‑language signs. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the open square; multi‑storey residential and commercial buildings line the street to the left and recede into the distance.
